about.description: Ventuals is the first production HIP-3 builder-deployed perpetual venue on Hyperliquid, founded by Alvin Hsia and Emily Hsia (previously builders of Shadow) and incubated by Paradigm. It pioneered private-company valuation perpetuals, letting users go long or short the implied valuations of pre-IPO companies like SpaceX, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Kraken with up to 10x leverage, alongside thematic public-market index perpetuals (MAG7, Semis, Robotics, Defense, Energy, etc.). Ventuals runs its own oracles blending off-chain valuation data with real-time perp pricing, and uses Privy for embedded wallets. All markets are margined and cash-settled, providing synthetic exposure to instruments that have historically been illiquid or inaccessible to retail.
about.registryInfo: Ventuals was founded by sibling duo Alvin Hsia and Emily Hsia, who previously built Shadow (an on-chain data extraction project). The platform was incubated by Paradigm and is the first production application of Hyperliquid's HIP-3 builder-deployed perpetuals standard, with Privy providing embedded wallet/custody infrastructure.

fees.revenueNotes: Ventuals is a HIP-3 builder-deployer on Hyperliquid focused on pre-IPO/private equity perps (xAI, SpaceX, etc.). Fees follow HIP-3 framework: standard taker ~7-9 bps, Growth Mode taker ~0.45-0.9 bps. 50% of fees go to Ventuals deployer, 50% to Hyperliquid protocol. Source: https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/hyperliquid-improvement-proposals-hips/hip-3-builder-deployed-perpetuals
